findings.summary: Latent/Attention regional control is supported but Region LoRA is not; a no-op Region LoRA must not be misdiagnosed as prompt failure.
A prior guidance-multiplication bug on newer Forge Neo models was fixed; older results can be runtime-confounded.
This release explicitly targets prompt adherence, multi-character binding, interactions, and spatial instructions; keep it a separate behavior profile.
Automatic post-generation detection/inpainting is postprocess evidence, not proof that the base prompt solved anatomy or binding.
Count, identity, attribute binding, spatial binding, and interaction binding should be evaluated separately.
Prompt-only and regional/control/postprocess-assisted success must stay in separate evidence lanes.

tool_impact: Track prompt-only vs control-assisted vs postprocess-assisted separately.
Do not infer base-model success from ADetailer or Regional Prompter outcomes.
